profile.name: ACQ400/ACQ2106模块化数据采集机箱
profile.description: 这是一类面向实验室瞬态记录与多通道测量的模块化数据采集机箱，可搭载多个采集站点或功能模块，通过网络输出通道原始数据、状态信息和校准数据，并支持同步、分段采集以及部分数字/波形输出功能。
profile.description_en: This is a family of modular data acquisition chassis for laboratory transient recording and multi-channel measurement. It can host multiple acquisition sites or functional modules, provide channel raw data, status, and calibration information over the network, and supports synchronization, segmented acquisition, and some digital or waveform output functions.
